description: Bush Fire Prone Areas (OBRM-001) is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Fire and Emergency Services. The Bush Fire Prone Areas (OBRM-001) dataset identifies current bush fire prone areas of Western Australia. This dataset is a copy of the most current bush fire prone area dataset which is currently the Bush Fire Prone Areas 2025 (OBRM-024). Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Fire and Emergency Services. Its tags are BPA, DFES, OBRM, bpa, bush fire. It offers 3 resource(s) in api arcgis server map service, wfs, wms. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
